releaseNotes:
🛠️ 4.1 Update!

- Many fixes across Crosshair, Auto Click, Shell Execute, Game Mode, Freeze Apps, Resolution and Texture Compression.
- Reset All is safer and restores your previous touch and animation settings.
- The app no longer closes when Shizuku isn't running.
- Fixed a false "unofficial app" warning on some networks.
- Premium: login works right after activation.
